div.p: Art. 27(1)(a)–(b): being late 8 times or absent 5 days in six months, after a written warning, allows dismissal without notice. The counts below run from .
Art. 61: normal hours are at most 8 a day and 48 a week (the working schedule). Art. 67(2): overtime at most 4 hours a day and 12 a week.
Art. 54, 59: wages are for work done; unpaid absence comes off the salary, and deductions stay under a third of the monthly wage unless the worker agrees in writing.

ol.li: On the device: Menu › COMM. › Cloud Server Setting (ADMS).
Server address: · Port: · HTTPS if the address is https. Proxy off.
Add the device here with its serial number (Menu › System info › Device info).
Punches arrive within a minute; "Last heard from" shows the device is talking.

div.div: The server must be reachable from the device's network (your public address, not localhost).
Way 2: a PC reads the device (older models)

ol.li: On a PC on the same network, install Python, then pip install pyzk requests.
Download the sync agent; the setup is written at its top.
Put the device IP and its token (Copy agent token) in zk_agent.json, with as the address.
Schedule it every 10 minutes (Task Scheduler / cron). Re-sending is harmless.
